# TUONDOKE
TUONDOKE ni mfumo wa usafirishaji, mizigo, pochi ya kidijitali na logistics Tanzania.

## Pages
- /
- /login
- /register

## APIs
/api/health - Health check
/api/auth/* - Authentication
/api/rides/* - Rides

## Features
- Ride hailing, cargo, wallet, insurance, membership
- Sync endpoints for recurring, budget, savings, activity log
